note: Reports ARPCE designated national electronic certification authority and an e-signature launch, but names no law it acts under and no accreditation, licence or rule made under a law, so no standing or reach fact.

facts.fact: The Minister of Post and Telecommunications described law 15-04 of 1 February 2015 on general rules for electronic signature and certification as the text currently in force, covering certification and electronic signatures only; the document is dated 2025-12-01 (month proxy) and gives no other date for this.
facts.system: Loi 15-04 du 1er février 2015 fixant les règles générales relatives à la signature et à la certification électroniques

facts.fact: A draft law fixing general rules on trust services for electronic transactions and electronic identification, which would replace law 15-04, was presented to the National People's Assembly (APN) by the Minister, following Council of Ministers approval on 2 November 2025; it recognises electronic contracts and electronic documents as equal to paper, creates the ANCE authority and sets sanctions.
facts.system: Projet de loi fixant les règles générales relatives aux services de confiance pour les transactions électroniques et à l'identification électronique

facts.fact: The Algerian government approved on 2 November 2025, in the Council of Ministers, a draft law on general rules for trust services for electronic transactions and digital identification, updating the 2015 electronic signature and certification legislation and giving electronic documents, signatures, seals and timestamps legal value equal to paper.
facts.system: Draft law on trust services for electronic transactions and electronic identification

facts.fact: Echorouk quotes the head of the national consumer-guidance organisation for e-commerce as saying most online sellers in Algeria operate without the obligations that Law No. 18-05 on e-commerce lays down, which treats the law as existing and binding; the document gives no event date, so the 2026-08-04 publication date is used.
TSA cites law 26-02 of 17 February 2026 setting general rules on trust services for electronic transactions and identification, under which the procurement portal's electronic signature operates.

The arrêté of 4 February 2026 cites law no. 15-04 of 1 February 2015 setting general rules on electronic signature and certification, and requires the portal to sign documents electronically under it; this is a signatures law only.
Digital Policy Alert says the Law on electronic commerce of November 2018 obliges e-commerce businesses to host websites on a .dz domain and register with the national trade registry.
Horizons says law 15-04 of 1 February 2015 governs electronic signature and certification in Algeria, and the AECE director says it leaves the choice between handwritten and electronic signature.

note: Reach fact struck at Level 1: the AECE is the authority the law sets up, offering certificates itself; no provider is accredited or licensed under the law.
The document states nothing on this study's aspects for this country that the study's questions ask.
The document states nothing about an e-commerce or electronic transactions law.

facts.fact: Algeria's Loi n° 18-05 of 10 May 2018, printed in Journal officiel n° 28 of 16 May 2018, sets general rules for e-commerce of goods and services: registration of e-suppliers, electronic offers and contracts, payment, advertising and penalties.
facts.system: Loi n° 18-05 relative au commerce électronique

systems.system: Loi n° 18-05 relative au commerce électronique

note: Articles 7 and 25 leave their terms to regulation; the text names no decree made.
Electronic signature mentioned only as a future use of advanced certification; no law stated.

facts.fact: UNCTAD's tracker lists Décret exécutif n° 19-89 of 5 March 2019 as Algeria's electronic transactions legislation, fixing how registers of electronic commercial transactions are kept and sent to the national commerce register centre.
facts.system: Décret exécutif n° 19-89 fixant les modalités de conservation et de transmission des registres des transactions commerciales électroniques

note: The line does not name a parent law; its subject is online sellers' transaction registers. Law 18-05 line held as DZA-004.
